name: Future Women Leaders in Law Enforcement (Fairfax County Police)
what_you_do: Explore law enforcement careers for women. You learn about patrol. You learn about crime scene investigations. You learn about the helicopter division. You learn about the police recruiting process. You also meet women leaders in the department.
who_can_apply: High school age girls in Northern Virginia (public, private or home-schooled) entering grade 10, 11 or 12 in the 2026-2027 school year. Class size is limited.
pay_detail: Free of charge. Transportation help is offered case by case.
deadline_text: The page says the 2026 class has graduated and to check back next year for 2027 session information. No 2027 dates are posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the program application on the page when the new session is posted. If you need a ride, email Captain Deanna Weand when you apply. Questions: 703-246-3332 or CPA@fairfaxcounty.gov.
notes: For girls only. Classes are at Fairfax County Public Safety Headquarters, 12099 Government Center Parkway, Fairfax. Participants are expected to go to all classes. Not a job.
